title: log_summary@2
description: One structured summary of one window of system log text. Every field is nullable. A field is null when the input does not contain the value. A model must not supply a value that the input does not contain.

host.description: The name of the machine that wrote the log, copied exactly as the input writes it. Null if the input carries no host name.

error_count.description: The number of lines in the window that report a failure. Null if the input states that it is incomplete, because the number is then not derivable.

first_error.description: The message text of the first line that reports a failure, copied exactly. Null if there is no such line, or if the message text is removed.

first_error_at.description: The time stamp of that same line, copied exactly as the input writes it. Null if there is no such line, or if the line carries no time stamp.

service.description: The program or unit that wrote the first error line, without the process identifier. Null if there is no such line, or if the line names no program.

max_severity.description: The highest severity that the input states, mapped to one of five levels. Null if the input states no severity.

service_restarted.description: True if the window records a service start or restart. False if the window records service activity but no start and no restart. Null if the window records no service lifecycle at all.
